call_points.text: CPG quarterly breakeven targeted in another 4-5 quarters, driven by value-added mix, new products and distribution.
Nutra steady-state EBITDA margin guided at 12-15%, contingent on building more scale.
Jaggery plant in Karnataka to commission in six months and more than double current jaggery capacity.
Combined jaggery turnover from both plants expected near ₹100 Cr once running.
Ethanol capacity is 582 KLPD, of which about 120 KLPD is grain-based.
Cane availability in TN and AP is a concern; crushing there is expected flat to 5% lower in the current year.
Karnataka is the only region that can make up the volume shortfall; late-August and September rains are critical to yields.
Employee costs rose on VSS at legacy plants, a one-off in one plant, with more such actions intended.
Non-core land parcels are being readied for sale to reduce debt, with something expected in FY27 but no quantum disclosed.
Switching ethanol to sugar is constrained by committed OMC volumes, with a per-litre penalty for non-supply.
No plans to rework the corporate structure around the Coromandel subsidiary at this point.
CFO and CEO noted that the CPG business aims to break even within the next 6-8 quarters.
The company is executing a ₹45 Cr capex for a new Jaggery facility in FY27.

entities.name: Parry Sugars Refinery India Private Limited

industry: Fast Moving Consumer Goods > Food Products > Other Food Products

operating_notes.text: PSRIPL loan obligations totaling ₹600 Cr infused by EID Parry by May 15, 2026.
Tamil Nadu units ran 54 days in Q1FY27 versus 37 days a year ago, crushing 1.47 LMT against 2.12 LMT, with gross recovery of 7.95% versus 8.02%.
Sugar sales volume rose to 0.89 LMT from 0.56 LMT, while the average selling price fell to ₹40.02 per kg from ₹40.97.
Distillery sold 380 LL (ENA 138 LL, ethanol 242 LL) at an average realisation of ₹63.49 per litre versus ₹67.59 a year ago.

EID Parry India Limited shared the audio recording link for its Analysts/Investor Conference Call on May 27, 2026, discussing audited financial results for Q4FY26 and FY26.
EID Parry held its Q4FY26 earnings call discussing refinery restructuring, ethanol trends, and CPG strategy.
On its 13 August 2026 Q1FY27 call, EID Parry said it had infused ₹665 Cr into PSRIPL to settle bank liabilities and guided CPG to quarterly breakeven in another 4-5 quarters.
